business_summary: North Mining Shares Company Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the exploitation, exploration, and production of molybdenum concentrate in the People's Republic of China. The company is also involved in property management operations. North Mining Shares Company Limited was incorporated in 1995 and is headquartered in Wan Chai, Hong Kong.
business_summary_ko: 투자 지주 회사인 North Mining Shares Company Limited는 중화인민공화국에서 몰리브덴 정광의 개발, 탐사 및 생산에 종사하고 있습니다. 회사는 또한 자산 관리 운영에도 참여하고 있습니다. North Mining Shares Company Limited는 1995년에 설립되었으며 홍콩 완차이에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
